snippet.title: Fortnite - Save the World: Going Free to Play April 16 | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/228748

After nearly ten years, the game that started it all welcomes even more players to join the fight. Save the World is going free to play on April 16. Grab your friends and team up to earn in-game rewards by pre-registering for launch. 

As a thank you for the last nine years of world saving, current players will receive Superchargers, Vouchers, and Gold on April 16.

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games #fortnite
